items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: That was Thomas' regular piano player. We called him Joe Lewis

ctx.x: I don't know Joe Lewis. I know Walter Lewis. Little bit of Brownskins, brother. Stay back on Pearl Street. Oh, I don't know where he lives. It might be the same guy that might
have two names. He drinks a whole lot. That's him. That was his regular piano. That was Thomas' regular piano player. We called him Joe Lewis, all in the
history of the life. Joe Lewis was a popular name about that time.
